title: Kotopoulo Riganato
subtitle: Greek roast chicken with lemon and oregano
excerpt: Chicken pieces roasted over sliced potatoes with plenty of dried oregano and lemon. The potatoes soak up the cooking juices and turn golden underneath. A simple, deeply satisfying oven supper.
sourceNotes: Greek home cooking tradition. Lemon and oregano roast chicken is a staple across the Greek mainland and islands.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate the chicken in lemon, olive oil and oregano for up to 24 hours in the fridge for a deeper flavour.

content.text: This is Greek home cooking at its plainest. Chicken roasts on top of potatoes that slowly absorb the lemony juices. Pull everything out when the potatoes are golden and the chicken skin is crisp.

items.prepNote: juice of both, zest of one

content.text: Heat the oven to 190C. Put the potato wedges in a large roasting tin in a single layer.
Mix the lemon juice, lemon zest, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper in a jug.
Pour half the lemon mixture over the potatoes and toss to coat. Pour in the water.
Sit the chicken legs on top of the potatoes. Pour the remaining lemon mixture over the chicken.
Roast for 50 minutes. The potatoes should be starting to turn golden at the edges.
Turn the potatoes over carefully. Roast for a further 20 minutes until the chicken skin is deeply golden and the juices run clear.
Rest for 10 minutes before serving. Spoon the pan juices over the chicken.

items.symptom: The potatoes are pale and soft, not golden.
items.cause: Too much liquid in the tin, or the oven was too low.
items.fix: Turn up the oven to 210C for the final 15 minutes and leave the potatoes uncovered.

items.symptom: The chicken skin has not crisped.
items.cause: The chicken was placed skin-side down, or there was steam trapping moisture.
items.fix: Make sure the skin faces up and the tin is not crowded. Pat the skin dry before roasting next time.

items.symptom: The dish tastes flat despite the lemon.
items.cause: The salt level was too low or the oregano was old and had lost its aroma.
items.fix: Season with more salt at the table. Use fresh dried oregano for a stronger result.
